description: Suggested production API contract for ARGsoft Solutions

auth.POST /api/auth/login: Authenticate HR user through a server-side identity provider
auth.GET /api/auth/me: Return current authenticated user and roles

jobs.GET /api/jobs: Public published jobs; supports q, location, type
jobs.GET /api/jobs/:id: Public detail for published jobs; HR can view private fields

files.POST /api/resumes/upload-url: Authenticated server creates short-lived signed upload URL
